title: Color keys
description: The key colors of a scheme, each with its name and token. Drawn by the ColorKeys composite as a band on Foundations › Color.

keys.description: Each key color, in the order the band shows them.

name.description: What the color is for, such as Action.

token.description: The token, without color., such as action.primary.

value.description: The CSS value drawn: the token's CSS variable.
